description: Set viewport dimensions and device emulation (device presets, geolocation, locale, timezone, color scheme, touch, orientation).

action.description: 'set' viewport/emulation, 'clear' all overrides, 'list' available device presets, 'preset' apply a named device.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

devicePreset.description: Device preset name for action='preset' (see action='list').

hasTouch.description: Whether to emulate touch support (defaults to the 'mobile' flag).

mobile.description: Whether to emulate a mobile device (default false).

name: browser_viewport
